For your gluten-free bread recipe, the best alternative to all-purpose flour to maintain an airy structure is a high-quality 1:1 gluten-free flour blend that contains xanthan gum or guar gum. These blends are specifically formulated to mimic the texture and binding properties of wheat flour, helping to trap air and create a lighter crumb. If your blend does not already contain a gum, adding 1/2 teaspoon of xanthan gum per cup of flour is recommended to improve elasticity and prevent the bread from being too dense or crumbly.
